license_boundary: Non-commercial research only; raw source assets and replay outputs remain ignored and are not provider inputs.
selection_policy: In official source order, inspect at most the first 200 train and 200 test identifiers, excluding M14 source families. Require the strict M14 parser and a final STEP. Select first accepted Line3D and Circle3D train cases plus first accepted test case; all selected source families must differ.
stopping_condition: Three fixed cases only. If any required slot were absent inside its 200-item bound, selection would stop without extending the scan or replay syntax. No feature-support expansion follows this record.

samples.failure_evidence: Strict parser accepted the feature class and failed with bbox max delta 1016 mm, volume relative delta 1.0, topology total absolute delta 13. M17-002 endpoint ordering left bbox/volume unchanged and reduced topology total absolute delta only to 11, so curve order is not a sufficient root cause.

runtime_boundary.notes: Selection and replay are local-only M17 evidence, not an executable corpus admission or hosted evaluation. The bounded expansion stopped after the held-out gate failure; no replacement sample or parser change was attempted.
